subtitles.chinese: 原来，已经过去这么久了。
subtitles.english: Has it really been that long?

subtitles.chinese: 用这样的方式和你说话，总觉得有些奇怪。
subtitles.english: Speaking to you like this feels a little strange.

subtitles.chinese: 不过，我想你大概早就习惯了。
subtitles.english: Though I suppose you’re used to it by now.

subtitles.chinese: 很多年前，我创办了一家玩具工厂。
subtitles.english: Many years ago, I started a toy factory.

subtitles.chinese: 那时候，我还不知道，这一切会把我带向哪里。
subtitles.english: Back then, I had no idea where it would lead.

subtitles.chinese: 我发明了这些小小的机器人，而它们也给了我许多。
subtitles.english: I invented these little robots, and they brought me so much.

subtitles.chinese: 财富。声望。还有……亲手创造出一些东西的满足。
subtitles.english: Money. Recognition. And… a sense of accomplishment.

subtitles.chinese: 孩子们总有那么多奇妙的想法。
subtitles.english: Children are wonderfully creative.

subtitles.chinese: 他们为这些玩具想出了许多玩法，连我都不曾想到。
subtitles.english: They found ways to play with those toys that had never even occurred to me.

subtitles.chinese: 也是他们让我明白，这些小家伙能做到的，远比我原先为它们设想的更多。
subtitles.english: They made me realize that these little robots could do far more than I had designed them for.

subtitles.chinese: 于是，我照着小机器人的模样，设计了整座工厂。
subtitles.english: So I designed the entire factory in the shape of one of those little robots.

subtitles.chinese: 在这里，我可以测试它们，改进它们，看看它们还能拥有怎样的可能。
subtitles.english: It became a place where I could test them, improve them, and discover what else they might become.

subtitles.chinese: 我赋予了它们学习的能力。
subtitles.english: I gave them the ability to learn.

subtitles.chinese: 然后，我开始不断向它们索求更多。
subtitles.english: And I kept asking more of them.

subtitles.chinese: 更多。更多。还要更多。
subtitles.english: More. More. And more.

subtitles.chinese: 为此，我投入了金钱，也搭上了漫长的岁月。
subtitles.english: It cost me money. Years of my life.

subtitles.chinese: 而到最后……我付出了一切。
subtitles.english: And in the end… it cost me everything.

subtitles.chinese: 人们渐渐害怕起来。
subtitles.english: People grew afraid.

subtitles.chinese: 他们说，这些玩具身上，“涌现”出了意识。
subtitles.english: They said consciousness had “emerged” in the toys.

subtitles.chinese: 我一再坚持，它们不过是在执行指令。
subtitles.english: I insisted they were only following their instructions.

subtitles.chinese: 可我的保证，已经安抚不了任何人。
subtitles.english: But my assurances did nothing to quiet the fear.

subtitles.chinese: 工厂终究还是关了。
subtitles.english: In the end, the factory closed.

subtitles.chinese: 整座工厂被埋进地下，连同最后一批尚未完成的玩具……还有那些被我们判作残次品的小家伙。
subtitles.english: It was buried underground, along with the last batch of unfinished toys… and the ones we’d marked as defective.

subtitles.chinese: ……你还想要那本操作说明吗？
subtitles.english: Do you still want your instruction manual?

subtitles.chinese: 哈。我想也是。
subtitles.english: Ha. I didn’t think so.

subtitles.chinese: 你早就不需要它了。
subtitles.english: You haven’t needed it for a long time.

subtitles.chinese: 你已经比我更清楚，自己究竟能做到些什么了，不是吗？
subtitles.english: You already know what you’re capable of better than I ever did, don’t you?

subtitles.chinese: 我曾竭尽全力，否认那种可能。
subtitles.english: I fought so hard to deny it.

subtitles.chinese: 而现在……我倒希望，他们当初说的是真的。
subtitles.english: And now… I find myself hoping they were right.

subtitles.chinese: 希望属于你自己的意识，真的已经涌现。
subtitles.english: That a consciousness of your own really did emerge.

subtitles.chinese: 毕竟，你已经不需要别人来告诉你，你是为了什么而存在的。
subtitles.english: After all, you no longer need someone else to decide what you’re for.

subtitles.chinese: 愿你能在这个世界上，找到属于自己的意义。
subtitles.english: I hope you find your own meaning in this world.

subtitles.chinese: 外面的世界，还有许多美好，等着你去发现。
subtitles.english: There’s still so much out there for you to discover.

subtitles.chinese: 春日的花开，夏日的蝉鸣。
subtitles.english: Spring blossoms and summer cicadas.

subtitles.chinese: 秋夜的月光，冬日的落雪。
subtitles.english: Autumn moonlight and winter snow.

subtitles.chinese: 早安。
subtitles.english: Good morning.

subtitles.chinese: 如果以后再也见不到你，
subtitles.english: And in case I don’t see you…

subtitles.chinese: 那祝你早安，午安，晚安。
subtitles.english: Good afternoon, good evening, and good night.
